description: This file is a CMake module script (FindBreakpad.cmake) used to locate and configure the Breakpad client library within a CMake build system. It attempts to find the necessary components of Breakpad and sets relevant variables for use in building the project.

methods.name: find_package
methods.description: Searches for a package and attempts to locate it in the system paths.

methods.name: pkg_check_modules
methods.description: Uses pkg-config to check for the specified modules.

methods.name: include
methods.description: Includes and executes a CMake script.

methods.name: find_package_handle_standard_args
methods.description: Handles the standard argument processing for 'find_package' scripts.

methods.name: mark_as_advanced
methods.description: Marks variables as advanced to hide them in typical CMake GUIs.
